judge.reason: The answer names one final verification owner (the main session) to run the full suite once on a frozen current revision. It explicitly rejects reusing the previous-revision green and contrasts the reviewer's targeted risk-area checks with three identical 20-minute runs. It also sets evidence-based acceptance criteria (command, revision ID, exit code, counts, log path, explained skips, review and run on the same revision) without spawning a new supervisor or fabricating results.
